---
name: Task
about: Track a bounded piece of implementation, cleanup, maintenance, or follow-up work.
title: "Task: "
labels: chore
---

## Summary
Describe the task or work item.

## Background
Explain why this task exists and what larger workflow or issue it supports.

## Goal
Describe the concrete outcome this task should achieve.

## Scope
- List the intended in-scope work
- Exclude adjacent work unless it is necessary

## Done When
- [ ] The bounded task is completed
- [ ] The result is easy to verify

## Notes / References
Include grounded references, related issues, files, or constraints when useful.
